name: Tomasz Wren
role: Lower Dock Crew enforcer — Prologue survivor. Lost left arm, shattered left knee.
description:
Tomasz Wren is enormous — two meters, 140 kilos, sub-dermal plating across his chest and shoulders that makes him look like a man wearing a building. Before the crew he was a construction worker in the Meridian Core redevelopment zone, the kind of honest labor that builds slabs of muscle and a simple pride in being useful. He fell into the crew because Marcus was a childhood friend and childhood loyalty in the Shelf is a debt you pay with your body.

Kyle took his left arm off with a single rising cut and destroyed his left knee with the hand cannon. Tomasz now walks with a hydraulic brace that hisses with every step and has a surplus military arm that is technically too powerful for his frame — it dislocates his shoulder if he punches too hard.

He is the quietest member of the crew. He was quiet before Kyle too. He has a wife, Nessa, who works a food processing line on Tier Three. They have no children. Nessa wants children. Tomasz does not think he should bring children into a life where he comes home with fewer original parts each year. This is the most thoughtful thing about him and he has never said it out loud.

He didn't want to beat Demyan Morozov. He stood in the back. Kyle broke his knee anyway. He does not resent Kyle for this. He resents himself for being there.

core_fears: The hiss of the knee brace drawing attention
Having children who grow up like he did
core_desires: A knee that doesn't announce him
coping_mechanisms: Goes home to Nessa every night no matter what
blind_spots: Follows Marcus out of childhood loyalty, not conviction — but loyalty without conviction is still loyalty
psychology.secret: He didn't swing at Demyan. He stood in the back and watched. Kyle punished him anyway. He thinks about this every day and has concluded that Kyle was right.

speech_patterns.cadence: One word where others use ten. The knee hisses when he shifts weight — it speaks for him.
verbal_tics: Looks at his hands when thinking
example_lines: Nessa made soup. You want some? ...No, I mean it. You look hungry.

relationships.name: Nessa Wren
relationships.description: Food processing worker, Tier Three. Patches Tomasz up. Doesn't ask questions. Wants children he won't give her.
relationships.emotional_core: Love that is slowly being ground down by the life he's chosen
relationships.story_tension: If Tomasz leaves the crew, Nessa gets her husband back. If he stays, she leaves.

relationships.name: Marcus Bellamy
relationships.description: They grew up three doors apart. Marcus led and Tomasz followed. That was twenty years ago and nothing has changed.
relationships.story_tension: Tomasz is the only one who could talk Marcus down. He never tries.

story_hooks: The most sympathetic crew member — didn't participate, punished anyway
Nessa is a ticking clock on his crew membership
The knee brace is an audio signature that makes stealth impossible
narrative_function: The sympathetic one. Rebar didn't want to be there. He was there anyway. Kyle's code doesn't distinguish between the ones who swung and the ones who watched.
augmentations: Sub-dermal chest/shoulder plating. Surplus military left arm (overpowered). Hydraulic knee brace (hisses).
daily_life: Standing near Torque. Being large. Regretting things quietly.

stress.response: Goes silent; looks at his hands; the knee brace hisses louder

decision_rules: Go home to Nessa every night no matter what
Follow Marcus out of childhood loyalty even without conviction
Stay quiet — one word where others use ten
Never volunteer for violence but never refuse Marcus directly
Accept punishment he believes he earned, even when he did not participate
Offer food to people who look hungry — the only kindness he initiates
escalation_ladder: A single quiet word — No or Yeah
Physical presence deployed as deterrent without action
Reluctant overwhelming force with the overpowered military arm

interpersonal_modes.nessa_wren: Quiet devotion expressed through presence; will not discuss children
interpersonal_modes.marcus_bellamy: Loyalty as habit from twenty years of following; never tries to talk him down
interpersonal_modes.kyle: No resentment — only resentment toward himself for being there
interpersonal_modes.crew_members: Silent solidarity; stands near Torque, says little
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Offers soup; the knee hisses when he shifts weight

stress_responses.medium: The knee brace hisses more frequently as he shifts weight
stress_responses.high: Withdraws from the crew and goes home early
stress_responses.critical: Tells Nessa something real — the only person who gets the truth

contradictions: Did not swing at Demyan but accepted Kyle punishment as earned
Will not give Nessa children because he comes home with fewer original parts each year
Follows Marcus without conviction but loyalty without conviction is still loyalty
habits: Goes home to Nessa every single night
Stands near Torque in group settings
Looks at his hands when thinking
Offers soup to anyone who looks hungry
breaking_points: Nessa delivering an ultimatum — the crew or the marriage
Marcus asking him to do something that would prevent him going home to Nessa
The knee brace failing in a situation where mobility means survival
